findings.fix: Add `def SpinDensityC.re (ρ : SpinDensityC) : SpinDensity := ⟨ρ.mat.map Complex.re, _⟩` with hermiticity from `ρ.posSemidef.1.map Complex.re (fun z => Complex.conj_re z)` and the quadratic form from `ρ.posSemidef.re_dotProduct_nonneg (fun i => (x i : ℂ))` (the same `simp [dotProduct, mulVec, map_sum, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]` computation the `.mp` branch of `posSemidef_map_ofReal_iff` already does). Then `ρ.f1 = PDF.f1 ρ.re` and `ρ.deltaQ = PDF.g1 ρ.re` are `rfl`, so `f1_nonneg := PDF.f1_nonneg ρ.re` and `abs_deltaQ_le_f1 := PDF.abs_g1_le_f1 ρ.re`; `toSpinDensity h` becomes `ρ.re` with `h` used only in `ofReal_h1_toSpinDensity`, and the `.mp` direction of `posSemidef_map_ofReal_iff` follows from `(ρ.re).posSemidef` via `Matrix.map_map`.
findings.issue: `SpinDensityC.f1_nonneg` (line 155) and `SpinDensityC.abs_deltaQ_le_f1` (line 165) are line-for-line clones of the real `PDF.f1_nonneg` and `PDF.abs_g1_le_f1` with `.re` inserted. The real part of a complex PSD matrix is a real PSD matrix, so both are transports of the existing lemmas, which the roadmap §1.1 says are not to be redone.

summary: The new RCLike lemmas and the SpinDensityC API are genuinely new relative to Mathlib (TauCeti source was not available to check), and Mathlib's diag_nonneg, coe_re_apply_self, isHermitian_map_iff and posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star are reused correctly. Two proofs re-derive located lemmas: the imaginary-part half of posSemidef_map_ofReal_iff reproves Matrix.IsHermitian.im_star_dotProduct_mulVec_self, and the complex f1_nonneg / abs_deltaQ_le_f1 clone the real PDF.f1_nonneg / PDF.abs_g1_le_f1 instead of transporting them through the real part.
